parsed.summary: You lost your bank card and national ID at Tunis‑Carthage airport. Act quickly: block the card, report the loss to police, obtain a loss certificate, and start replacement procedures for both documents.

steps.action: Call your bank’s emergency number or use the mobile banking app to place an opposition (block) on the lost bank card. Verify recent transactions and note any suspicious activity.
Go to the nearest police station or the airport police (post 197) to file a loss report for both the bank card and the national ID. Request a written receipt (attestation de perte).
Keep the police receipt; it will be required by the bank and the civil‑identity office for replacement requests.
Contact your bank (via phone, app, or branch) to request a replacement card, providing the police receipt as proof of loss.

Visit your local civil‑identity office (or the nearest consular service if you are abroad) with the police loss certificate, your passport or other ID, and a recent photo to apply for a new national identity card (CIN). The law requires renewal within 30 days for a lost card.

steps.when: After receiving the new card and ID
steps.action: Activate the new bank card, update any linked services, and change passwords for accounts that may have been compromised.
